notes: The full reference directory and pilot evidence are staged separately at review time and must be copied into final package before sealing.

The runner emits epoch50_checkpoint.json, includes that metadata in the feedback bundle, and preserves the full per-epoch training checkpoint including epoch50. After epoch50 the metadata records its SHA256, optimizer steps, scale learningrates and included training state; before then it explicitly reports unavailable.
Exact CUDA resume is not guaranteed by the retained backend; the review establishes code invariants, not GPU bitwise behavior.
